reason: No subscription is nice and 99 baht once is okay, but I can already make basil pork, I wouldn't shop for green curry on a work week, and cooking three dishes on Sunday sounds like too much for my small kitchen corner and little fridge. So I'd poke around the free part and delete it like most apps I try.
objection: Why pay for recipes when TikTok, YouTube and my mom on LINE are free? I'm not convinced an app chef does any better.
would_change_my_mind: If I actually cook the free green curry and it comes out clearly better than my YouTube tries, I'd pay the 99 baht.
